The low expression of CD3 and CD45RO is suggestive of an M2-like macrophage phenotype, which are often found in the tumor microenvironment. The presence of CD4 and CD20 could indicate the presence of a mixed population of macrophages and B cells.

BioMistral.title: Macrophage-enriched
BioMistral.description: Macrophages are likely enriched in this cluster, which exhibits high expression of CD68 and PDL1, and low expression of CD8a and anti-CD45RO. The cluster also shows high expression of CD45_PE, which may indicate a proliferative state. The presence of CD31 suggests a potential association with the vasculature. The cluster is also characterized by high expression of LaminABC_488 and Desmin_555, which may indicate a stromal or fibroblastic phenotype.

MedGemma.title: Tumor-Infiltrating Lymphocytes
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents a population of tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs), possibly T cells. The high expression of markers like Keratin, LaminABC, and Desmin, along with the presence of CD3 and CD8a, suggests a possible co-localization with tumor cells. The low expression of CD45RO and CD3, along with the presence of PD1 and FOXP3, is consistent with a subset of T cells that may be exhausted or regulatory. The presence of CD20 and CD4 suggests the presence of B cells. The high PCNA and Ecad expression suggests proliferation and epithelial characteristics. The overall profile is suggestive of a T cell population, possibly with a degree of exhaustion or regulatory function, coexisting with tumor cells.

BioMistral.title: Epithelial-like cells
BioMistral.description: Epithelial-like cells are characterized by high expression of PCNA, Ecad, LaminABC, and Keratin. They also express PDL1 at low levels. These cells are likely to be malignant epithelial tumor cells, which are known to express these markers. They may also be associated with stromal cells, as indicated by the high expression of CollagenIV.

MedGemma.title: Epithelial-like cells
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents epithelial-like cells, consistent with the high expression of Keratin_570, Ecad_488, CDX2_647, LaminABC_488, and PCNA_488. The low expression of markers like anti_CD3, CD4_488, CD8a_660, CD163_488, and CD45_PE is suggestive of a non-immune cell population. The presence of Desmin_555 and Vimentin_555 may indicate a degree of epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) or a mixed epithelial/mesenchymal phenotype. The high PCNA expression suggests active cell proliferation.

BioMistral.title: Epithelial-like cells
BioMistral.description: Epithelial-like cells are characterized by high expression of epithelial markers such as Ecad_488 and CDX2_647, as well as nuclear markers such as LaminABC_488 and Desmin_555. These cells are also positive for PCNA_488, a marker of proliferation. They are negative for immune markers such as anti_CD3 and anti_CD45RO, as well as markers of myofibroblasts such as aSMA_660 and CollagenIV_647. The cells are also negative for markers of other cell types such as CD4_488, CD163_488, and FOXP3_570. The cells are likely to be epithelial cells, possibly with some degree of proliferation.
